tasks.title: Notify adopts the fixed contract while retaining its existing hostile-input guards
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, Shared finding, all Behavior bullets and Completion evidence; Rollout order 2, Performance impact, Security impact and Acceptance evidence (whole feature) 5. After contract merges, record/reuse the same full merged main SHA as other consumers. Keep noRedirect/capture wrappers, fixed apiError text, URL redaction, rejected-item handling and all #553 guards unchanged.

acceptance.command: bun install && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check
acceptance.expected: exit 0; lint, typecheck, full tests and unchanged >=80% line coverage pass, including unmodified test/api-hostile.test.ts, test/api-limits.test.ts and test/security-review.test.ts.

acceptance.command: git diff --exit-code main -- src test/api-hostile.test.ts test/api-limits.test.ts test/security-review.test.ts
acceptance.expected: exit 0, no output; production guards and the three hostile-input suites remain unchanged.

acceptance.command: git diff main -- package.json bun.lock docs/operation.md
acceptance.expected: Only the contract dependency line changes in package.json, to github:lorenzh/pulse-contract#<full merged main SHA containing #864/version 2.5.2>; bun.lock resolves that same SHA. Verify the merge on contract main independently and record/reuse the shared finding from the first consumer so probe, status, notify and console adopt the same SHA. Commit package.json and bun.lock together; other pins stay unchanged. Operation docs say the shared client also refuses redirects and compressed answers under Bun and notify keeps its own redirect manual wrapper.

acceptance.command: bash -c 'TIMEFORMAT="%U %S"; for run in 1 2 3; do time bun run test; done'
acceptance.expected: Per Performance impact's primary measurement in each changed repository, run three test suites per side on main and candidate on the same machine, reporting individual user+system sums and medians. Use bash builtin time, not /usr/bin/time; no extra test CPU is expected from this pin/docs adoption.

acceptance.command: git diff --check && gh pr view --json body,statusCheckRollup
acceptance.expected: Whitespace exits 0 and repository-required CI checks pass. PR records full merged contract SHA and shared-finding provenance, check results and the applicable Security impact checklist: fixed secret-safe diagnostics, bounded bodies, redirect protection and full-SHA/lockfile consistency. No new dependency or setting. PR records unchanged hostile-input-suite results, empty src diff and CPU medians; notify's #553 guards are retained.
